title: Detent Engage — promotional cut
reader: A CRO or founder who already has, or has considered, a chat agent on their website.
reaction: Ours gets paid whether it works or not. This one doesn't.
note: Led by the commercial model rather than by a safety feature list. Being paid per booked meeting is the difference no other chat agent can copy without changing its own business, and the governance is framed as the consequence of that promise rather than as the headline. No code, no JSON, no configuration screens.

beats.big:
Every other chat agent
gets paid whether
it works or not.

Detent Engage is paid
when it books the meeting.

beats.lower: So it cannot chat. It has to qualify.
Scale. Requirement. Timing. Authority. In that order.
It tells every visitor it is AI.
It will not try to identify anyone until they say yes.
A booked meeting, with the conversation attached.

beats.small: Paid on outcomes, not on conversations.
